title: Peacock wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail feathers fan -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='38' ry='30' fill='#0d6e5c'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='32' ry='25' fill='#11897a'/>
    <!-- tail feather eyes -->
    <circle cx='22' cy='42' r='6' fill='#1fb39e'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='42' r='1.6' fill='#2d5bff'/>
    <circle cx='35' cy='32' r='6' fill='#1fb39e'/>
    <circle cx='35' cy='32' r='3.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
    <circle cx='35' cy='32' r='1.6' fill='#2d5bff'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='6' fill='#1fb39e'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='3.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='1.6' fill='#2d5bff'/>
    <circle cx='65' cy='32' r='6' fill='#1fb39e'/>
    <circle cx='65' cy='32' r='3.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
    <circle cx='65' cy='32' r='1.6' fill='#2d5bff'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='42' r='6' fill='#1fb39e'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='42' r='1.6' fill='#2d5bff'/>
  </g>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='17' ry='20' fill='#2d5bff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='12' ry='13' fill='#1f3fbf'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='45' y='46' width='10' height='18' rx='5' fill='#2d5bff'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='11' fill='#2d5bff'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='6' fill='#7fd6ff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points='50,44 62,46 50,50' fill='#f2a03d'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='42' r='2' fill='#fdf6e3'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='42' r='1' fill='#101c3d'/>
  <!-- crest -->
  <line x1='50' y1='32' x2='47' y2='26' stroke='#7fd6ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='25' r='2' fill='#7fd6ff'/>
  <line x1='52' y1='32' x2='53' y2='25' stroke='#7fd6ff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='24' r='2' fill='#7fd6ff'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,12 40,33 60,33' fill='#ff4f8b'/>
  <polygon points='50,12 44,27 56,27' fill='#ff8fb5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='11' r='3.5' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='22' r='1.6' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='24' r='1.6' fill='#7fd6ff'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1='46' y1='95' x2='44' y2='99' stroke='#f2a03d' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='95' x2='56' y2='99' stroke='#f2a03d' stroke-width='2'/>
</svg>
